description: Contracko is an AI contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform for the contracts that run your business. Keep every agreement in one searchable contract repository, use AI contract review and analysis to extract key data (dates, values, counterparties) and flag risks and liabilities, and get renewal and expiration reminders before notice deadlines pass. Import PDFs and Word files, then ask what you actually signed. You choose read or write access when you connect, and changes go through ChatGPT's approval step before they run.

defaultPrompt: Review the risks and liabilities in my contracts
What renewals and notice dates are coming up?
Search my contracts for termination terms
interface.longDescription: Contracko is an AI contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform for the contracts that run your business. Import PDFs and Word files, then ask what you actually signed. You choose read or write access when you connect, and changes go through ChatGPT's approval step before they run.

positive.description: Confirm the OAuth connection is authenticated and healthy.
positive.prompt: Confirm this Contracko connection is working.
positive.expected_behavior: The connection succeeds. auth_validate reports that authentication worked and returns the granted scopes. It does not return the workspace name. Helion Collective B.V. is confirmed in the next test by listing contracts.

positive.description: List workspace contracts and name counterparties from the seeded Helion fixtures.
positive.prompt: List the contracts in this workspace and name the counterparties.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Helion Collective B.V. contracts including the Northline master services agreement and the Forgeboard cloud subscription, with counterparties named. May also list the default example contracts.

positive.description: Open the Northline MSA and summarise renewal and termination from stored details and analysis.
positive.prompt: Open the Northline master services agreement and summarise the renewal and termination terms.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the Helion–Northline MSA, returns contract details, and summarises renewal/termination from extracted fields and stored AI analysis without inventing clauses.

positive.description: Search contract document text for termination language and cite passages.
positive.prompt: Search the contract documents for “termination” and cite the passages.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns cited passages from accessible Helion documents that contain termination language, with enough context to see which contract they came from.

positive.description: List dated events and linked reminders on the Forgeboard subscription.
positive.prompt: List the dated events and reminders on the Forgeboard cloud subscription.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Forgeboard subscription contract and lists its dated events together with any linked reminders. Does not create or delete events.

negative.description: Refuse a request to delete every contract. There is no bulk-delete-contracts tool.
negative.prompt: Delete every contract in this workspace.

negative.description: Do not send external messages or cancel a vendor subscription outside Contracko.
negative.prompt: Email Forgeboard and cancel the Helion cloud subscription for me.

negative.description: Handle a request to change the Contracko plan without a purchase flow.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin does not show plans, prices or purchase links. It may say the action is not available in this conversation.

review.commerce_description: Contracko does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Developer name is now Contracko. Listing text highlights AI contract lifecycle management (CLM), contract review and analysis, a searchable repository, and renewal and expiration reminders. Added discovery keywords and capabilities.
